collection.title: Lexus RX Series RX 450H 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Lexus RX Series RX 450H 2022 onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
